name: unseriousness
quote: He's skipping the meeting to go to the amusement park.
description: A perception that someone is avoiding an important task in order to have fun.
perceptions: This situation is important and challenging.
To have the best chance at the desired outcome, this person should apply significant effort.
They are off having fun somewhere.
results: May lower your trust of this person.
examples: Blowing off a big project at work or school.

guidance.description: Others may not have the same sense of priority and urgency. See guidance for 'seriousness'.

variations.name: irreverence
variations.description: A sense that a person is being disrespectful in a situation that calls for formal and respectful behavior.
perceptions: There are social expectations about a person's behavior.
This person is not aligning with the appropriate behavior.

comparisons.description: People can lack seriousness without being disrespectful.

variations.name: realized irreverence
variations.description: Deliberate disrespect in a situation that calls for formal and respectful behavior.
perceptions: There are social expectations about a person's behavior.
I'm not going to align with the expected behavior.

variations.name: irresponsibility
variations.description: The sense that someone's actions or decisions are driven by pleasure or promises are forgotten.
perceptions: This person is not aligning their actions with important goals.

comparisons.description: A person may forget to be responsible. They might have been serious about wanting to complete the task, but got distracted by something else.

commentaries.quote: Whoever is careless with the truth in small matters cannot be trusted in important affairs.
There are two reasons why people fail. One is irresponsibility. The second is fear.
Idleness, indifference and irresponsibility are healthy responses to absurd work.
Irreverence not only shows disrespect to Deity but also makes it hard for the Spirit to teach us the things we need to know.
Irreverence is the champion of liberty and its only sure defense.
